audit_metadata.title: ML Service QA & Reliability Comprehensive Audit Report

bugs.expected: Card numbers, tokens, and PII must be masked with [REDACTED]
bugs.actual: Plaintext payment card and bearer token printed directly to log output
bugs.impact: Severe regulatory and compliance violation (PCI-DSS, GDPR, SOC2)
bugs.root_cause: Blacklist checks dict keys only instead of value-level recursive regex masking
bugs.recommended_fix: Implement recursive value regex masking for payment cards, tokens, and emails in safe_log

bugs.impact: Official Google domain quarantined as phishing attack, breaking support channels
bugs.root_cause: 'googl' lookalike token matches 'google.com' via substring check without authentic domain guard
bugs.recommended_fix: Bypass lookalike check when domain matches genuine brand, and refine substring matching

bugs.reproduction: Check text overlap between train.csv and val.csv
bugs.actual: 13.37% of validation texts and 13.12% of test texts are exact duplicates of train texts
bugs.impact: Holdout splits contaminated by training samples; invalidates generalization metrics
bugs.root_cause: Stratified row-level split without message-level deduplication on raw dataset containing 11k duplicates
bugs.recommended_fix: Deduplicate texts or apply group/hash-based split by complaint text before train_test_split

bugs.reproduction: Evaluate model on holdout test set (scripts/evaluate.py)
bugs.expected: Macro F1 >= 0.75, balanced accuracy across categories
bugs.actual: Macro F1 = 0.1065, Accuracy = 16.59%. Minority classes have 0% recall. 97.5% abstention at th=0.5
bugs.impact: Classifier fails on real-world complaints; almost 100% of complaints require manual review
bugs.root_cause: Severe class imbalance (604:1), noisy intent mappings, and lack of balanced class weighting
bugs.recommended_fix: Retrain with cleaned labels, balanced class weighting, calibrated thresholds, and intent alignment

bugs.reproduction: Send 'Someone has stolen money from my account right now' to /api/v1/analyze
bugs.impact: Active monetary fraud/theft is handled with standard automated canned response
bugs.root_cause: Security incident rule requires security_risk: HIGH from URL/email; fallback rule is STANDARD_SUPPORT_RESPONSE
bugs.recommended_fix: Add rule mapping urgency: CRITICAL to ESCALATE_TO_SECURITY_TEAM or HUMAN_REVIEW regardless of category

bugs.reproduction: UrgencyDetector().detect('₹20,000 was deducted incorrectly and I need this resolved urgently.')
bugs.impact: High-value monetary dispute delayed because adverb 'urgently' does not match regex
bugs.root_cause: Regex uses \burgent\b word boundary which does not match 'urgently', and lacks monetary error regex
bugs.recommended_fix: Update regex to \burgent(ly)?\b and add patterns for currency deductions

bugs.impact: Phishing attacks with masked short URLs evade quarantine and warning thresholds
bugs.root_cause: Shortener adds only 0.25 score; threshold for MEDIUM is 0.40
bugs.recommended_fix: Increase URL shortener penalty to 0.40 or enforce minimum MEDIUM risk for shorteners

bugs.expected: 15 distinct topic clusters across diverse business categories
bugs.actual: 14 clusters generated (1 dropped); 100% of clusters have dominant_category: DELIVERY_SHIPPING_PROBLEM
bugs.impact: Clustering dashboard offers zero visibility into payment, security, or product defect issues
bugs.root_cause: Dominant category skewed by majority class and lack of stop-word filtering on pleasantries ('thanks', 'good')
bugs.recommended_fix: Add domain stop-words, filter short conversational pleasantries, and rebalance clustering

bugs.expected: Records real Macro F1 and Accuracy in reports/model_quality_gate.json
bugs.impact: Quality gate displays 0.0 even when classification metrics are computed
bugs.root_cause: Script queries m.get('macro_f1') instead of m.get('overall_metrics', {}).get('macro_f1')
bugs.recommended_fix: Update qa_benchmarks.py to parse nested overall_metrics dictionary

bugs.expected: QA test suite passes without schema attribute errors
bugs.impact: Test crashes prematurely due to enum name mismatch
bugs.root_cause: Enum value is PAYMENT_TRANSACTION_ISSUE in schemas.py, but test used PAYMENT_ISSUE
bugs.recommended_fix: Update QA test files to use canonical BusinessCategory enum identifiers
